my_sentence: Only one of my classmates became to a writer.
correction: Only one of my classmates became a writer.
explanation: "Become" is a linking verb and takes the noun directly, with no preposition "to." The teacher repeated "became a writer" to remove the extra "to."
correct_examples: He became a teacher after college.
She became a doctor last year.
context: Talking about why being a writer is an unusual job.

my_sentence: AI become more and more, become smarter and smarter.
explanation: "AI" is a singular subject, so the present-tense verb needs the -s ending: "becomes." The teacher supplied "becomes more and more."
context: Explaining why a dentist cannot be replaced by AI.

my_sentence: In other countries, they are earned a lot too.
correction: In other countries, they earn a lot too.
explanation: (assistant note) "Earn" is active here — the people do the earning — so use the plain present "earn," not the passive "are earned," which would mean they themselves are being earned.
correct_examples: Dentists earn a lot in other countries too.
context: Saying dentists earn a lot in many countries, not only China.

my_sentence: In my country we don't keep culture, so we just pay the basic money, not for tips.
correction: In my country we don't have a tipping culture, so we just pay the basic price.
explanation: The natural phrase is "have a tipping culture," not "keep culture." The teacher confirmed the intended word was "tipping."
correct_examples: China doesn't have a tipping culture.
We don't have a tipping culture, so we just pay the bill.
context: Explaining that Jack does not tip his dentist.

my_sentence: Data is very important for more than companies.
correction: Data is very important for modern companies.
explanation: Jack meant "modern," but pronounced it so that the teacher heard "more than." Stress the first syllable of "modern" (MO-dern) and keep the "d" clear so it isn't confused with "more than."
correct_examples: Modern factories use a lot of automation.
context: Explaining why data scientists have the best job.
